issues.detail: The Greek 'απεκριθη αυτω' (answered him) is missing. The Vietnamese 'thưa rằng' (said/replied) captures the response but omits the specific recipient ('him').

The Greek 'ουκ αρκουσιν αυτοις' uses a plural verb and pronoun, indicating the bread was not enough for 'them' (the disciples/people). The Vietnamese 'không đủ cho mỗi người' (not enough for each person) slightly shifts the focus from the collective group to the individual distribution.
